content:
kai: Quick ask — can someone run a smoke onboarding perf bench for hyrax-13b (int8) across GPU and dedicated-cpu nodes? Need p50/p95/p99, TTK, and mem usage for seq=2048, batch=1 and batch=4. Also include a short kernel/profile snapshot if possible. Thanks!

alex: I can kick this off on the dedicated-gpu pool. queueing now. i'll do batch=1 then batch=4. will tag results.

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-1772405599-hyrax13b-001. Estimated run time ~ 35m. Logs -> s3://redwood-onboard/hyrax-13b/bench-1772405599/

nat: please make sure prefix-cache is enabled for the GPU run and disabled for the CPU run so we can compare worst-case. also include kv-cache hit rate in the log.

alex: got it. commands i'm using:
```
bench-run \
  --model hyrax-13b-int8 \
  --seq-len 2048 \
  --batches 1,4 \
  --iters 200 \
  --prefix-cache true,false \
  --profile pprof \
  --output s3://redwood-onboard/hyrax-13b/bench-1772405599/
```

jjohnson: add --warmup 20 and collect per-request tail latencies (p99,p999). we saw p999 anomalies on the last onboarding.

alex: running now (warmup=20). i'll post a short summary when done.

(≈22m later)

alex: quick summary (first pass, GPU dedicated):
```
batch=1, GPU:
  p50 = 14.2 ms/token
  p95 = 38.7 ms/token
  p99 = 92.1 ms/token
  throughput = 120 tok/s
  mem = 12.1 GB (model) + 2.2 GB (runtime)
  kv-cache hit = 0.0 (prefix cache disabled)

batch=4, GPU:
  p50 = 9.5 ms/token
  p95 = 26.3 ms/token
  p99 = 74.0 ms/token
  throughput = 410 tok/s
  mem = 12.1 GB + 3.6 GB
  kv-cache hit = 0.0
```
Note: these are int8 runs with kernel-selection set to auto.

alex: CPU dedicated (no prefix cache):
```
batch=1, CPU:
  p50 = 98 ms/token
  p95 = 320 ms/token
  p99 = 1.2 s/token
  throughput = 12 tok/s
  mem = 15.4 GB
```

nat: thanks — that P99 on CPU is expected. can you re-run GPU batch=1 with prefix-cache enabled and kv-hit logging turned on? want to see tail improvement when cached.

alex: re-run queued for GPU with prefix-cache=true, attaching pprof profile. new job -> bench-1772405910-hyrax13b-002

bench-bot: Job started: bench-1772405910-hyrax13b-002. Logs -> s3://redwood-onboard/hyrax-13b/bench-1772405910/

(≈8m later)

alex: GPU w/ prefix-cache enabled (batch=1):
```
p50 = 11.8 ms/token
p95 = 21.6 ms/token
p99 = 33.8 ms/token
throughput = 210 tok/s
kv-cache hit = 82%
```
pprof flamegraph uploaded: https://internal.redwood/profiles/hyrax-13b/1772405910/flame.html

jjohnson: nice — big tail improvement with caching. can you also snapshot the kernel list from the runtime? want to check if we fell back to slower matmuls for long seq.

alex: kernel list from job:
- attention-optim-qli (use)
- fused-gemm (use)
- matmul-fallback (partial)
logs: s3://redwood-onboard/hyrax-13b/bench-1772405910/kernel-log.txt

maria: small note — there was a noisy neighbor on GPU node g-22 during the first run. not sure it affected p95 but worth re-checking.

alex: re-run comparison after lunch on an isolated node to be safe. will re-run the initial batch=1 int8 without noisy neighbor and post final numbers.

kai: thanks team. once you have the isolated numbers, please paste a one-paragraph summary and link the two bench paths (initial + isolated + profile). i'll publish to the onboarding doc and drop a short note on the model catalog.

nat: i'll prepare the onboarding checklist entry (quant note, recommended batch sizes, prefix-cache guidance) once final numbers are in.

(≈30m later)

alex: final isolated run uploaded: s3://redwood-onboard/hyrax-13b/bench-1772406120/final-summary.md
final numbers (isolated GPU batch=1, int8): p50=13.9 ms/token, p95=27.2 ms/token, p99=38.5 ms/token, throughput=190 tok/s. profile + kernel logs in the same folder.

kai: perfect. i'll update the catalog: recommended default = batch=4 for throughput, batch=1 with prefix-cache for latency-sensitive endpoints. noted CPU perf is not production-friendly. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
